# [Baseline] - WIN - D - Shared Devices OneDrive

Signs OneDrive on shared devices in silently with the work account, puts Desktop, Documents and Pictures in OneDrive and keeps files online-only, including those of synced team sites, so that nothing stays behind in a profile that Shared PC cleans up and the disk does not fill up with a copy per user.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | — |
| Source | Own baseline — the same values as [Baseline] - WIN - D - Microsoft OneDrive for silent sign-in, Files On-Demand, Known Folder Move and the allowed tenant, plus Convert synced team site files to online-only files (DehydrateSyncedTeamSites, Microsoft Learn: Use OneDrive policies to control sync settings). |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_D_Shared_Devices_OneDrive.json`](Baseline_WIN_D_Shared_Devices_OneDrive.json) |

> Belongs on SG-D-UEM-WIN-Shared, next to [Baseline] - WIN - D - Shared PC or Shared PC Domain and Guest. A template of its own, so that the Shared Devices baseline in CIPP-Baselines can deploy OneDrive without putting [Baseline] - WIN - D - Microsoft OneDrive on a group. The shared settings have the same values as that policy, so both on one device is no Conflict. The Settings Catalog ID of DehydrateSyncedTeamSites follows the pattern of the other OneDrive settings and is not literally in any source: if CIPP rejects the template, look the setting up in the Settings Catalog (Convert synced team site files to online-only files) and use that ID.
